title: Man arrested over attacks on Jewish community in London
originalTitle: Man arrested over attacks on Jewish community in London
content:
Police investigating attacks on the Jewish community in London have arrested a man on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts.

The 37-year-old man was arrested on Sunday at an address near Barnstaple, Devon.

The arrest is part of an ongoing counter terrorism investigation into a series of attacks on premises linked to the Jewish community in north west London, an attack on a Persian-language media organisation and the discovery of jars of a non-hazardous substance in Kensington Gardens.

The Metropolitan Police said, since an attack on Hatzola ambulances in Golders Green on 23 March, officers had arrested a total of 26 people.
